```{r}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

#Print cube numbers of 1 to 20
for(i in seq_len(20))
{
  print(i^3)
}

#Print 5 random 5-letter character strings
for(i in seq_len(5))
{
  print(paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse=""))
}

#Building a data frame of a 10-course breakfast
breakfast_option <- c("hash browns", "bacon", "fried eggs", "mushrooms", "toast")
breakfast_table <- tibble()
for(choice in seq_len(10))
{
  current_row <- tibble(
    Course = sample(breakfast_option, size = 1), Number = sample(1:5, size = 1)
  )
  breakfast_table <- breakfast_table |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(breakfast_table)
```
